compilerOptions._comment_declaration: OFF deliberately. Nothing consumes this package's .d.ts — CDK's NodejsFunction esbuilds from src/index.ts and dist/ never ships. With declaration emit ON, adding any new route to contract.ts failed the build with TS7056 ('inferred type exceeds the maximum length the compiler will serialize'), because the error is raised only when TS must WRITE a declaration for the router. Turning it off removes that ceiling; turning it back on reinstates it.
